reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly staff. Vet Louise as always, was very attentive to our cat and continues to give us support and advice for him.
Had our dog Chester for his booster yesterday the vet was very attentive and Chester was quite at ease
Was seen urgently and staff very professional but friendly

Fab experience getting my 7 pups their micro chips and vaccinations and health check. Everything went so smoothly from weigh in, to puppies checked over, to getting jab and microchips done. All staff were fabulous and so helpful. Would definitely rec this vet for their caring, friendly service.
Huge thank you to all.  Jean

Ted is on the mend
a big thank you to all the staff at Sandyhills and Baillieston for the care and attention on the operation of my dog Ted.
Fantastic vet care and attention is wonderful highly recommended
Again very good service. Unusual for my dog she got nervous but vet put her at ease and got her relaxed. Definitely recommend this vet great with your baby

Scotvet I'm very grateful for, as the staff always go above and beyond for my girls. My girl Bessie is in lifetime care club amazing value and best money I have ever spent. Staff at Scotvet are amazing with my girl as she's very nervous.
Scotvet standards are very high and professional. I always leave very happy and satisfied.
I would never attend another practice.
Thank you Scotvet very much.
Great care and compassion from the receptionist and prompt appointment . Vet I got on Monday was lovely so helpful and attentive to Poppy .
Fantastic they where amazing with Broxy, even though broxy was shouting at them with his voice they gave me all the information I need am thankful

My Willow has been coming here for many years now and has the lifetime plan which helps a lot. The staff are all so friendly and the vets are great with Willow. She is an excitable cocker spaniel and although she's an older girl now she still thinks she is a puppy. We always leave with any questions asked fully explained and a treat of course 😁

The vet I saw was very friendly towards both my dog Ella and myself. I went there due to crusty spots that appeared on Ella’s skin. He said they were nothing to worry about but he said that as I was paying for a full consultation I should get my moneys worth and he examined her in full and gave her an MOT. The vet was really nice and seemed very caring towards Ella who took to him straight away. He was knowledgeable and approachable and I was very satisfied with his attitude towards both Ella and myself.
Vet was brilliant with mollie so understanding and very helpful
Always have time for questions and concerns and are always very helpfull

I love this vet. Very sad to be leaving. The girls at the front are always so friendly and kind and the vets themselves treat my baby like their own. Mabel never gets super stressed and they are always so sweet to her. Really recommend if you are looking for a place that actually cares about animals and not just a paycheck
Love taking my pet here staff are super friendly and so helpful amazing team super helpful and kind
The care given to my dog, and compassion shown to me and my wife when our dog had to be put to sleep due to illness recently was incredible and I would like to thank all at Sandyhills.

My dog developed discharge from one of their eyes and when I called up to enquire I was offered a same day check up appointment. I normally attend the baillieston clinic but was seen by sandyhills. The vet was very thorough to check there were no scratches and prescribed eye drops to help. They also offered me advice of what to look out for incase it got worse and gave me reassurance about what to expect which was really helpful for a first time dog owner.

Highly recommend both scotvet clinics. All the staff are very welcoming and super helpful.

Just moved to Scotland and looking for an independent veterinary practice..  then out of the blue my young dog started to go off her food, began vomiting and became lethargic.

I was delighted to be warmly welcomed to register for this practice and they found a last minute appointment to see my ill dog.

I am very grateful for their kindness and support and, of course, for the reassuring check up and prescribed medication which seems to have settled her upset stomach.
Excellent service at Sandyhills today.
Scotvet is wonderful had Lexi at Baillieston and sandhills and both are superb  I would recommend Scotvet
Excellent service thankyou
Thank you callum was very helpful
Dog treated like royalty
Always a pleasure
Very friendly staff at front decks ,vets r fab with Sasha as she's always scared I was a bit shocked at price for Sasha getting bloods done
Amazing as always with my cats best interest always xxx
Very happy with the service i received with my puppy.

After a query to the emergency vet. Sandyhills clinic contacted me the next morning to offer an appointment to get my dog seen that day. Always professional, always make my dog and I feel comfortable and our issue was resolved with great advice and some medication. Been with sandyhills clinic for nearly 14 years, always been 10/10 ⭐️
Brilliant service and really friendly staff. Highly recommend
The vet was friendly, professional and great with our cats
Excellent care of Oscar, our 9 year old collie. Staff are welcoming & extremely competent
New vet and she was lovely with my old boy... I am very grateful for that as he is my treasure xxx

Max is a German Shepherd dog, he has a very anxious nature. He gets extremely anxious when going to the vet.
The vet staff are very helpful when booking Max in for an appointment.  We are given appointments at quieter times, this helps Max and us a lot, as he is less anxious as there are no other animals around..
The staff at the vet are great, they are very cheerful, friendly and caring towards the pets and their owners..
They are very professional and knowledgeable in their field..they are very mindful of Max's fears and deal with him to suit his needs..
The surgery is always clean and tidy..
We have the monthly payment plan which covers the cost of most of Max's visits, which is ideal for my son as he has a low income..
I would recommend the Sandyhills practice to anyone..
A definite 5 stars to the practice and staff.
Always kind and always helpful

All dogs were in to have meds checks. Bobby and Charlie were also having annual check-ups and vaccinations.
Louise is very calm and patient with them especially when they decide they've been stood on the table for long enough and need persuading for a little while longer!
Daisy did well considering she had to have anal glands emptied (and it's so undignified for a princess!).
Thanks to everyone for their patience and kindness when we bring the gang 🙏

Tali loves a trip to the vet. The attention she gets from the moment she goes in is lovely to watch. Louise gave her a great check up and put my mind at rest.
Would not go anywhere else as they are all lovely.

Unfortunately used this vet surgery for a couple of years while living in Glasgow. Very uneducated and incompetent people. Kept telling me my elderly cat was overweight and that we had to get him down to 5kg. Every time we attended, they fixated on his weight. They convinced me it was this major issue, took him off of Hill's z/d and put him on Royal Canin Satiety, despite him having colitis.

Moved back to my hometown, re-registered with another vet, was told that he should be 6kg and was seriously underweight. Turns out I was being repeatedly instructed to starve him. The fact he was vomiting regularly and going to the toilet outside of his box was also ignored.

Ended up ultimately being diagnosed with a heart murmur, CKD and has a bit of a liver issue. Honestly, don't risk going here, because they'll quite literally have you abusing your own animal and can't even recognise the most common issues found in older cats. Vile and cruel.
Recommended by a neighbour. Had a great first visit. Staff very welcoming and friendly and happy to help. Vet also made Max very welcome and answered all our questions and and gave us lots of advice.
Fast and efficient appointments. Our wee Lubo was unsure as he had a sore paw. They reassured him with cuddles and treats. Love Scotvet Baillieston and Sandyhills

Took my dad’s dog to get her claws cut.  The staff were fantastic and very patient with her.
A very caring compassionate team.
Excellent visit as always. Flynn doesn't ever have a problem going in, he loves the attention. The staff are all lovely too 😊 …

I would highly recommend scotvet sandy hill's they always give my pets 💯 care you are also greeted with a very warm welcome and they are very helpful and friendly and give very good advice every time. …
I have been bringing my wee boy to the Sandyhills surgery for 18 years, and they have been amazing! Craig is Jinx's favorite vet.

This practice is amazing! I booked to have my cat neutered. I had to reschedule first appointment and the staff were so nice about it. When I took my cat in the vet was so welding and professional and put my mind at ease. I would definitely recommend.

Our dog is hyperactive and gets super excited when meeting people and with him being a Staffy a lot of people are afraid of him including the last Vet we show but this time round the Vet was soo good with him she knelt down of the floor with him.  Took him off the lead and allowed him to get as excited as he wanted and she then brought in an assistant so she could distract him while she examined him and she done the same knelt beside him and allowed him to jump all over him instead of being scared of him and we really appreciated that and he loved it and allowed them to examine him without problems.
Super fast service seen my dog on Friday 14th  August for a check up she is 16 years old and as with older dogs I was worried about a few things. All seems ok and put my mind at rest
Been going to this vet for nearly 12 years great service and very helpful, love the care they give my wee dog would definitely recommend, thanks and keep up the good work 🐾🐾 …

I joined the practice over 2 years ago I had heard lots off good things about it so decided to register my dog with them and I'm so glad I did I find them really caring and attentive they look after my dog needs very well From the vets the nurses to the admin staff everyone is really nice
Very friendly staff who make you feel at ease as well as being absolutely amazing with your pet.
Great experience staff where lovely gave my dog treats and provided water would definitely recommend and costs are reasonable
Feel so comfortable within this vets, friendly and caring towards my boy ❤️!
Lovely reassurance from the vet who took their time to examine my cat and check she was okay

I have been coming with my cats to this vet for over 30 years, l have seen a lot of positive changes. The care my cat Barney is receiving is second to none, lovely caring staff, putting my mind at ease, giving good advice, and keeping my cat healthy

Excellent vet , always get an appointment to suit ,
Staff are so friendly and approachable,  always explain everything so well .
Been using scot vet for last 4 years with my dog and wouldn't take him anywhere else , so patience with him and always make a fuss of him .
Always great service. Mittens is always well looked after when she comes in for her little manicure & pedicure
Was at this vet today with Louis.Got taken right on time and the Vet was great and gave me a lot of information a big Thankyou from me and Louis ❤️❤️
Great friendly knowledgeable team always have a smile and great advice for our Dora

The best vets - the way in which they all deal with your pet. I lost my boy 10yr old Alfie back in April to IVDD and honestly I cannot fault staff at Sandyhills I was allowed to stay with my boy for as long as I wanted. Thank you. We now have a new addition to the family Daisy our Cavapoo and she has been welcomed by all staff 💕
Dogs came in for booster shots , taken on time . They were checked thoroughly, weighed and given a treat for good behaviour 😊
Amazing vet my dog like them more than me 😂😂 very reactive Rottweiler until she goes there

I have used ScotVet for many years with all my pets both dogs and cats, they are so caring and sensative, all the counter staff are so polite. Pepper is quite happy,he never scratches . I am sorry to say my Pepper was killed on the road last year. The vets were so helpful and simpathetic, they arranged for Pepper to be collected by the crematorium and returned for me to collect him.

Hopefully we have managed to help my lovely cat, after he has had a few scary fits loosing control, we hope now that we have the right medication, but so far so good - early to really be sure - but we are hopefull our cat will get past this. thank you for your help :->
Excellent care for my doggos at Scotvet! Everyone is very friendly and puts them at ease with their patience and kindness. Affordable & always able to get an app when needed. Would recommend-10/10
Louise and Bekka are the vets I see, has be great and all the staff at vets regarding the care of clover...lots of cuddles for her when they see her.  All the staff care so much about your pet xxx

Been using the veterinary for over 18 years.  The practice staff are fantastic and very knowledgeable. Its got a family atmosphere and the attention to our Animals has been the best. Can't thank everyone at the practice enough for all they have Done for our beloved fur babies.  Thank you all. David

As always the staff were friendly and helpful. The reception staff fussed over my dog whilst he waited to be seen.
The vet - Callum - was lovely. He took his time with Bailey as he knew he was in pain and was thorough in explaining my pain management options.

Thanks team
Roy can be a bit aggressive if he dose not know you but the vet was patient and understanding with him.. great staff
Great vets,very helpful & nothing is a bother to them.My cats are calm with their treatment.Jack&Victor.
Got an appointment with Craig on 10/07/2026.As usual very pleased with his care and attention to my two frenchies Shug and Elsie.Great vet practice both here and Baillieston.
Best vets ever been with them forever for all my dogs they ate great my wee floki
Very nice staff. The vet was brilliant with our Rottie. Defo recommend them

Have been with this vet for a long time with my two chihuahuas. Always had the best care. Best advice. Most caring service and the reception staff from both Sandyhills and baillieston have been amazing. Couldn’t ask for a better more committed team. L x

After joining the Scotvet lifetime care club my french bulldog Clyde was due his kennel cough drops so took him in yesterday he got weighed, had a full check up got his flea and worming tablet all for the £25 I pay a month great vets great service would recommend joining its well worth it, I can take him as many times as needed with no cost if medication is needed that’s all you pay for.

Thank you for alleviating our worries over any possible reaction Clover may have had to his booster injection. Last year was horrendous given his reaction, but your explanation this time around, the preparatory advice and calming reassurance (despite my obvious emotional worry), made all the difference. And wee Clover showed no adverse reactions this time round either!!  Thank you for everything and for your understanding ❤️
We saw Callum who was so nice and reassuring. All staff are just so lovely and genuinely care about us and our boy (who runs straight in!)

Freddy was relax way vet he was plessent and explained evrrything.  I would not change my vet also the reception girls were very nice n polite they help u in any way.  Great vet  and animals   look after so well.  Thank u
Wonderful friendly receptionists, fantastic caring nurses and very informative and reassuring vets.Thank you all so much.

I've been attending Sandyhills for many years, I find the whole team very caring and recently have been attending with Dougal my Westie due to an eye ulcer , Craig has been very good with Dougal ,   he explains everything in full.
Many thanks.

All the team at both The Sandyhills and Baillieston Surgeries are excellent.

Our vet Craig, in particular, is by far the best  we've had and treats our Rescue Golden Retriever Hector with care, compassion and professionalism.

I strongly recommend The Practice to anyone looking for a new, or change of vet and will continue to entrust our dog in their care.
Excellent vet. Have given fantastic care for our greyhound every time we visit.
Baillieston is my normal vets but had an emergency and they could fit me in at Sandhills it was very much appreciated excellent service would highly recommend ScotVet

Spike loves going into the vets. He’s always treated well.
The vets try to get to the route of his problems and give us choices to make the best decision for him.

Excellent experience phoned this vets practice first thing in the morning and got an appointment straight away and I had never uesd them before the girls at reception were outstanding on getting my dog's files transferred over to them from my previous vets the vet was allso very knowledgeable and friendly and arranged medication and a follow up appointment for my dog so far so good I would recommend this vet 👍
Great veterinarian, a real professional 👍👏 …

Dear Scotvet
I would like to thank this wonderfull vet practise for all there skills help and support over the years for the care and love shown throught my dogs life and recently when he had to be put to sleep.
I no how dedicated the whole team are but would like to specially mention Craig, Mirren,cheryl,Callum
And the practise manager lizzie.
You are all very kind special people and I will be forever greatfull for all the help you provide my big pal
MURPY
THANKS MATT , JULIE MCCUSKER

Been using ScotVet  for past 3 years with champ, they have been absouloutly brilliant. The care plan has saved us money, with visits. Vaccinations and flea and worm treatments included in the plan.  Recently champ required emergency surgery, Staff were on the ball and had him sorted swiftly, and thanks to their experience in dealing with insurance companies our claim was paid in full, I can't thank them enough, and Champ recommends them highly

I had taken my wee pup for his second vaccination yesterday. Right from the moment he went through the door he  was put at ease, girls were brilliant making a fuss which he loved.
The vet was great answering all my questions and was really great with  Vinnie to the point he didnt realised he had been jagged. Great first appointment which will make it easier getting the dog to go back.

Super attention & follow up care via the 'phone recently due to one of our dogs having a really horrible skin infection on his nose. Now resolved. Our two dogs are very well cared for by the whole team. Always able to get appointments quickly. Thank you.

Had Gunner a 12st Dogue de Bordeaux at Scotvet Sandyhills on Friday a got a clean bill of health although they keep an eye on his weight he just loves the girls and a wee treat. thanks to the Shettleston Team. Highly recommended place to take your pets for great advice and care.
Sympathetic and understanding. Would recommend

Great staff and always really good with my cat bargeera and you can always pick up the phone if you have a question about your pet and they will always be helpful 😊🐾😺ps even when he is not in good mood to they are great with him ☺️ …

Very caring and compassionate as well as reasonable cost which helps, only Beto have dealt with who send a wee card weeks after having to say cheerio to a fur family member. pets all my life had a few vets and this one is by far the one for us as a family.
Always a great experience for me and my dog
Milo had has first visit here and I was nervous of how he would be - not need to worry they were amazing with him and he was reassured and calm. Fab vet highly recommended

Amazing people who care for your pet. In the process of immigrating and the team here have been so helpful not just to my dog Mishah but also to myself.
Guiding me through all the legal procedures to allow her to come with me has been amazing.
Thank you all so much
George and Mishah
Excellent overall service. Took my dog in for yearly vaccination, she is always nervous in vets but the staff were brilliant with her. Calmed her down no problem. Ten out of ten.
Friendly staff, booked my pet in very quickly and were prompt with the appointment time. Vet very knowledgeable and explained everything we needed to know.  Wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else now
I have attended Sandyhills Vets for many years. They offer excellent small animal expertise and care.
Great staff
Great care with Baby Taffy Thank you So much x She has no Fear of coming to see the Vet x.

Phoned and has an appointment within the hour, vet I saw was brilliant, receptionist was also fantastic, took my little 18year old dog Roxy there will be using this practise in future and would highly recommend it, thanks you guys
As always very happy with staff and the care they provide to my pet. Thanks guys!
Brambles first visit and the staff and vet where tremendous :) so thorough and took a lot of care thank you again we certainly have a happier cat today
Jasper and Luna get well look after . Much appreciated
Can't thank the ladies at Scotvet Sandyhills enough. Managed to trim my very feisty cat's claws today. Riggie was not a happy kitty and let everyone know. Well done. Back home to relax.
We've been with this practice for nearly 20 years and cannot recommend Bieke and the team enough. They are just wonderful and we know our pets are always in the best of hands with them.
Good thorough service. Vet very competent and polite. Reception staff very nice too. No hanging around waiting to be seen.

I ran to sandyhills vets in my first week of having a new puppy. I was completely distressed after my little one had diarrhoea and sickness. I was looked after (and my pup was too🙂by a wonderful girl called jenna, she was so patient with me and my pup. Advised all the right medication and things to follow thru over the next few days. I have to say my pup was back to great health the next day because of Jenna. I registered with sandyhills vet that evening and would be happy to boost about the fabulous care that day from the staff.
Everyone very helpful and caring joined the vet club very reasonable prices..thank you brilliant with kira
All staff are lovely and takes good care of animals

Review for [sandyhills Vet Clinic]

I have been extremely pleased with the care my cat has received at [sandyhills Vet Clinic ]. From the moment I enrolled in the full-year care plan, I felt a great sense of reassurance knowing that my pet’s health is being consistently monitored and supported. The team is compassionate, professional, and attentive to every detail, making each visit as stress-free as possible.

The full-year care plan has been particularly valuable for me, as it ensures my cat receives regular check-ups, vaccinations, and preventative care without having to worry about scheduling each service separately. This plan not only provides peace of mind but also demonstrates the clinic’s commitment to long-term pet wellness.

Back in the day, I had Rottweilers too and did a fantistic job careing for them so there is history with this clinc. It means a lot to have a clinic like this looking after my current pet with such dedication and understanding.

I genuinely appreciate the care, guidance, and kindness shown by everyone at the clinic. Their dedication to the health and well-being of pets is evident in every interaction. I highly recommend [ sandyhills Vet Clinic ] to anyone seeking reliable, professional, and compassionate veterinary care.

I took my wee kitten to Scot Vet for her jags and flea treatment i found the staff to be very caring and helpful. I took out Insurance and a Pet Plan with them and will be going there from now on and Im sure wee Daisy will be happy when she pays them another visit. Thankyou to everyone at Scotvet
I have been with this practice for 25 years would never go anywhere else Sienna was down for her booster and health check up they are always so kind and caring and go above and beyond to help ❤️🐾🐾 …
Honestly couldn’t thank the 2 lady’s today and the girl that handed my wee fur baby 💔they were the most kindest people ever and handed me her so gentle honestly can’t thank yous enough ❤️ …
Very good very courteous and treated my dog with respect
Always friendly and welcoming and I trust them with the care of my 2 cats
It’s very organised the workers are very polite, patient and great with the animals
Yes they are very good with my Bella . It was my friend Yvonne brown that said to me to go there . Because she been going there for years with her two cats
Thank you for giving Gingie his jags and helping him feel at ease D Semple

Fergus &paco in for nail clip and weight management for monthly drops staff very friendly and helpful as well as being very caring towards my cats they were not fazed by there visit to the vet great job from all the staff🥰 …

The entire team are so welcoming and helpful. We registered Freddie with Sandyhills when he was a puppy due to feedback from other people and I know we made the right choice as Freddie is very settled with them and they are fantastic with Freddie would recommend them to all pet owners. First Class service provided at every appointment Fantastic Team x
Great vet very friendly and accommodating staff, saw Reggie in an emergency situation straight away ! Can’t thank them enough
Very helpful staff, experienced reassuring and made the entire experience so much easier. The vet doctors are thorough and professional.

Fantastic vet care from opening the door till leaving our three staffies are registered here amazing care when our oldest had to be pts .. our youngest attends regularly for her ears she loves going to see her vet and our middle boy is very anxious he was great and was allowed to sniff around as much as he wanted until he settled at 12 years old he has became very sensitive to loud noise traffic, banging even the orange walk he hides away ... all vet staff and vet professionals are amazing  always welcoming 🙏 will assist with any questions at all and do anything to settle anxious pets very hands on .. never had a bad visit

Very good experience as a new customer. Craig was absolutely fantastic and explained everything that he was doing and told us all our options. Very happy to bring all our pets here in future. Excellent staff, highly recommend.
Very happy with the service.  All the staff are always very nice.

Maverick had an abscess that needed immediate treatment. The vet was lovely, took her time to make sure the dog was comfortable. He is highly strung but she managed to keep him calm with her empathetic manner. Operation pending so will further update.

Couldn’t recommend a better vet for my little Frankie , reception team are amazing friendly , love the fact they also check in and see when Frankie little brother Freddy  due in goes to show they remember each little fur baby comes through the door.

Girls behind the desk are always  friendly out going and very  supportive

And the vets who have treated Frankie over the last year all been amazing haven’t had any issues , very informative regarding procedure , aftercare
